description: Projects and packages managed by TMS Smart Setup for the Delphi/RAD Studio ecosystem

repository.note: Smart Setup resolves products from configurable servers. The default repository, https://www.smartsetup.org/, is the central Smart Setup registry that routes to the underlying sub-registries — the public open-source registry and vendor-operated servers, such as those published by TMS. Product ids are unique across servers; the repository_url qualifier identifies a specific non-default server or source repository.

namespace_definition.note: There is no namespace. The vendor or owner identifier is part of the native dotted Smart Setup product id.

name_definition.note: The name is the full native Smart Setup product id, a dotted identifier such as 'tms.biz.aurelius' or 'sglienke.spring4d'. It must be lowercased.

version_definition.note: The version is the native version identifier understood by Smart Setup for the product, such as a server-published product version. The native version identifier is preserved rather than imposing an additional versioning scheme.
normalization_rules: Use the version string exactly as published by the Smart Setup server for the product; do not pad or truncate version segments.

qualifiers_definition.description: A non-default Smart Setup package server or source repository from which the product is obtained, when it is not the default community registry.
